query:
SELECT p.id, p.packageType, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.startDate, p.endDate, p.isActive, p.deductedMinutes
FROM packages p
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka'
ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC;
